name: Twice Baked Sweet Potatoes with Cranberry-Orange Butter

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry sweet potatoes. Prick all over with a fork, then transfer to a baking sheet pan.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until sweet potatoes are tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, about 1 hour. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly, 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut butter into small pieces. Place in a small bowl and set aside to soften.
Place cranberries and orange juice in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat and let soak, 30 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup dried cranberries
1 cup orange juice

instructions.primary_message: Strain soaked cranberries (reserving orange juice in a bowl for later use if needed), pressing on the cranberries with the back of a spoon to extract as much liquid as possible.
Roughly chop cranberries and add to the bowl with the softened butter. Use the back of a spoon to mash and combine the cranberry butter. Set aside.

When the sweet potatoes are cool enough to handle, slice in half lengthwise and carefully scoop the flesh into a medium bowl, leaving about 1/4-inch of sweet potato attached to the skins. Return potato skins, cut-side up, to the baking sheet.

Add half of the cranberry butter to the bowl with the sweet potato flesh, along with salt and pepper. Using a potato masher, mash until filling is smooth and combined (add reserved orange juice, by the tablespoon, if needed, to loosen the mixture). Spoon the filling back into the potato skins. (Set aside remaining cranberry butter for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to bake sweet potatoes until the filling is warmed through, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, transfer sweet potatoes to a serving platter and top with reserved cranberry butter. Enjoy!
